commits.subject: fix: Replace datalist suggestions with custom combobox component

comments.body: `aria-controls` always points at `listboxId`, but the listbox `<ul>` is only rendered when `isOpen && filteredSuggestions.length`. This can leave `aria-controls` referencing a non-existent element, and `aria-activedescendant` can also reference a non-existent option when `highlightedIndex` is out of range after filtering.

The suggestion options are rendered as `<button>` elements, which are tabbable by default. In a combobox/listbox pattern, options generally should not be in the tab order (arrow keys + `aria-activedescendant` handle navigation), otherwise users can unexpectedly tab into every suggestion.

### 🟡 Changes recommended

The new combobox has a couple of concrete accessibility issues (invalid `aria-controls` / `aria-activedescendant` references and tabbable list options) that should be fixed before approval.

*Once you've addressed the issues Copilot identified, you can request another Copilot review.*

<summary>Pull request overview</summary>

This PR replaces native `<datalist>`-based suggestion inputs with a custom, headless-composable-driven combobox component to work around Chromium-based mobile browsers not showing datalist popups, restoring suggestion UX across the affected forms.

- Added `useSuggestionFilter` composable for filtering + dropdown open/close + cyclic highlight navigation.
- Added `SuggestionTextInput` component implementing a combobox/listbox UI with keyboard + mouse interactions.
